#!/bin/bash

# Script to install fonts for the workspace
echo "Installing fonts..."

# Create fonts directory if it doesn't exist
mkdir -p ~/.local/share/fonts

# Download and install Fira Code font
echo "Downloading Fira Code..."
wget -q https://github.com/tonsky/FiraCode/releases/download/6.2/Fira_Code_v6.2.zip -O /tmp/firacode.zip
unzip -q /tmp/firacode.zip -d /tmp/firacode
cp /tmp/firacode/ttf/*.ttf ~/.local/share/fonts/

# Download and install JetBrains Mono font
echo "Downloading JetBrains Mono..."
wget -q https://github.com/JetBrains/JetBrainsMono/releases/download/v2.304/JetBrainsMono-2.304.zip -O /tmp/jetbrainsmono.zip
unzip -q /tmp/jetbrainsmono.zip -d /tmp/jetbrainsmono
cp /tmp/jetbrainsmono/fonts/ttf/*.ttf ~/.local/share/fonts/

# Download and install Cascadia Code font
echo "Downloading Cascadia Code..."
wget -q https://github.com/microsoft/cascadia-code/releases/download/v2111.01/CascadiaCode-2111.01.zip -O /tmp/cascadiacode.zip
unzip -q /tmp/cascadiacode.zip -d /tmp/cascadiacode
cp /tmp/cascadiacode/ttf/*.ttf ~/.local/share/fonts/

# Update font cache
echo "Updating font cache..."
fc-cache -f ~/.local/share/fonts

echo "Fonts installed successfully!"
echo "Installed fonts:"
echo "  - Fira Code v6.2"
echo "  - JetBrains Mono v2.304"
echo "  - Cascadia Code v2111.01"
